project_info.theme: Teal-and-orange neon streetwear portrait in an urban tunnel
project_info.color_palette: teal, bright orange, yellow neon, cream, deep shadow

main_subject.detail: An adult man with round glasses looks down toward the camera with a confident calm expression. He wears an oversized light-colored hoodie with a warm orange sweater visible at the neckline.

items: low-angle vertical portrait with the man looking down at camera
oversized light hoodie and warm orange inner layer as central wardrobe elements
soft neon bokeh receding into the background

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: dramatic bright orange and yellow neon lighting
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: strong teal-and-orange contrast with vibrant highlights and focused illumination on face and hoodie
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: bold night-city energy with high-fashion urban presence

technical_specs.render_style: 35mm cinematic fashion portrait with shallow depth of field
technical_specs.color_treatment: intense teal-and-orange grade, vibrant neon highlights, controlled soft bokeh

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic cinematic fashion portrait of an adult man with round glasses in an urban tunnel at night. Frame a low-angle shot as he looks down toward the camera with a confident calm expression. Dress him in an oversized light-colored hoodie with a warm orange sweater visible at the neckline, in a modern urban streetwear style. Use bright orange and yellow neon tunnel lights, glowing reflections, strong teal-and-orange color grading, intense contrast, and focused dramatic illumination on his face and hoodie. Shoot with a 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft neon bokeh, and ultra-detailed cinematic clarity. Keep the mood bold, vibrant, and high-fashion.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, readable text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: If supplied, use an approved adult face reference and preserve its facial structure, proportions, features, and expression. Preserve round glasses, light hoodie, orange sweater layer, low camera angle, neon tunnel, and teal-orange grading. Do not use celebrity/public-figure likeness or readable signage.

assets.name: approved-adult-face-reference
assets.usage: Maintain adult face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression.

changes: Clarified the subject as an adult while preserving the original streetwear, tunnel, neon palette, low angle, and high-fashion energy.
